community_list_entries.name: Keep It InMind: Benchmarking the Implicit-Association Blind Spot in Agent Memory

phase1_classification.kind_reason: A benchmark of 125 expert-verified tasks. Each puts a personal constraint (e.g. an allergy or a pending immigration case) into a 47-session LongMemEval-s trace, and a later indirect query needs that fact through a world-knowledge bridge. Paired controls separate storage, knowledge and retrieval fail
